g.title: LIPO_QSP
g.text: Lipodystrophy Syndromes — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
adipose tissue as a finite mechanical buffer AND the afferent endocrine signal reporting its size
one lesion, two deficits · overflow cascade to liver/muscle/plasma/pancreas · metreleptin effect = occupancy x signal deficit · drug PK/PD

g.title: cluster_gen
g.text: 1 · Aetiology (many causes converge on one lesion: lost adipocyte mass/function)

g.title: cluster_adipo
g.text: 2 · Adipocyte differentiation & lipid-droplet machinery (sets Vmax and capacity)

g.title: cluster_depot
g.text: 3 · Depot-specific storage capacity (the ceiling is a distribution, not a number)

g.title: cluster_influx
g.text: 4 · Daily lipid influx J_in (the numerator of the overflow problem)

g.title: cluster_buffer
g.text: 5 · The buffer function: capacity-limited esterification (where the model's non-linearity lives)

g.title: cluster_over
g.text: 6 · Overflow cascade (fixed order: SC → visceral → liver → muscle → plasma → pancreas)

g.title: cluster_leptin
g.text: 7 · Leptin axis: the afferent signal, its SATURATING transducer, and the deficit term

g.title: cluster_adipok
g.text: 8 · Other adipokines (a second, non-replaceable endocrine loss)

g.title: cluster_insig
g.text: 9 · Insulin signalling: ectopic-lipid-driven resistance and its SELECTIVITY

g.title: cluster_gluc
g.text: 10 · Glucose homeostasis, beta-cell trajectory and HbA1c

g.title: cluster_liver
g.text: 11 · Liver: steatosis → steatohepatitis → fibrosis (the irreversible arm)

g.title: cluster_tg
g.text: 12 · Plasma lipids: chylomicronaemia and the pancreatitis threshold

g.title: cluster_metr
g.text: 17 · Metreleptin PK/PD — occupancy is easy, the deficit is the constraint

g.title: cluster_ppar
g.text: 18 · PPARγ agonists — the only agents that touch CAPACITY (and only if depots exist)

g.title: cluster_tglow
g.text: 19 · TG-directed agents — they clear the SPILLOVER, not the influx or the capacity

g.title: cluster_end
g.text: 21 · Clinical endpoints & biomarkers (what a trial measures)

g.title: cluster_infer
g.text: 22 · Structural inferences and their falsification tests

g.title: D_MECH
g.text: PRESERVED in CGL1, LOST in CGL2

g.title: G_BSCL2
g.text: site; most severe, bone marrow fat

g.title: D_FEMGL
g.text: sink — lost in FPLD2 and all GL

g.title: D_EXPAND
g.text: — the ONLY term a TZD can move

g.title: D_VISC
g.text: expanded in FPLD, absent in CGL2

g.title: F_JIN
g.text: J_in = dietary TG + DNL + NEFA re-esterification

g.title: Q_TIER
g.text: Plasma TG is tier 5 of a cascade.

g.title: L_DEFICIT
g.text: — a PATIENT property, not a dose property

g.title: L_PERIPH
g.text: NOT a primary VLDL inhibition — that
draft predicted the clamp would make
steatosis worse, so it was discarded

g.title: L_HYPER
g.text: — the deficit feeding the capacity problem

g.title: Q_PAIRFED
g.text: Under a food-intake clamp 57% of the
hepatic-fat benefit and 35% of the HbA1c
is real but smaller than the appetite arm.

g.title: H_CIRR
g.text: HCC (leading cause of death in CGL)

g.title: V_DECOUP
g.text: plasma TG ↓↓ while hepatic fat and
HbA1c barely move — TG is a marker

g.title: Q_EQUIV
g.text: A diet that cuts J_in by the same
effect should match it on TG and HFF,
but NOT on the direct peripheral term.

g.title: Y_INSTRA
g.text: 1.4% and leaves hepatic fat and TG
